heading: What the 23 annotations do
body: Setup gives factories (functions that create objects) that you write yourself. On managed Yon roles, Needs finds the provider dependencies and writes the field assignment. Unmanaged behavior types and Tac still create objects in code that you write. CacheSettings, Cached, UpdateCache and ClearCache manage cache operations that are authorized and limited. PageDefaults normalizes input (puts it into a standard form). It does not fetch a collection or slice it. Entity, Table, object-form Store and Query give mappings and read-only structured queries. They are not an ORM (object-relational mapper), and they do not give migrations (scripts that change the database structure). HTTP request annotations are for outgoing requests. It is never a route decorator. Settings, WhenProfile and WhenSetting bind (copy values into typed fields) and select configuration that you give yourself. Checked, Check, Required, NotEmpty, Length, Min and Max validate the direct fields of JSON values. RequestRoute and the method route annotations define Yon endpoints. Put cache policies on services, after request authentication. AllOrNothing names the entities adapter (code that connects Tachyon to a data store) that handles begin, commit and rollback. Every Store command inside a transaction (a group of changes that all succeed or all fail) carries that adapter. `Gateway` is a Yon-only marker outside these 23. It declares a method that another language answers (see Calling a method in another language).
